svg.title: Falcon 9 First Stage Reusability — technical line art
svg.desc: Source-derived monochrome vector tracing of Falcon_9_First_Stage_Reusability_Graphic.jpg by SpaceX Photos (2015), CC0/public domain. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Falcon_9_First_Stage_Reusability_Graphic.jpg. Original layout, flight trajectories, and wording retained. Dark background, grid, stars, decorative smoke, and logo swatch removed; solid hardware simplified into outlines. All shapes and lettering traced from the supplied raster, not redrawn. Detail is limited by the original JPEG resolution. Transparent background.
